# Results

## Introduction
<!-- key: introduction -->

FIXTURE-BASE-INTRO: what the probes measure, for a reader new to them.

## Optical depth
<!-- key: optical-depth-tau -->

FIXTURE-BASE-TAU: the optical depth from large-scale CMB polarisation is
tau = 0.058 ± 0.006 (fixture value after a reanalysis, not a measurement).

### Low-ell likelihoods
<!-- key: low-ell-likelihoods -->

FIXTURE-BASE-LOWELL: two low-ell polarisation likelihoods are in use.

## Shear calibration
<!-- key: shear-calibration -->

FIXTURE-BASE-SHEAR: multiplicative shear bias priors of order one per cent.

## Cluster mass calibration
<!-- key: cluster-mass-calibration -->

FIXTURE-BASE-CLUSTER: weak-lensing masses calibrate the richness–mass relation.

## BAO scale
<!-- key: bao-scale -->

FIXTURE-BASE-BAO: the sound horizon at the drag epoch, as in arXiv:9999.00010.

## Neutrino mass
<!-- key: neutrino-mass -->

FIXTURE-BASE-MNU: a section added by the update.
